title: imagemeta PNG metadata decoding can exhaust memory
summary: Crafted PNG metadata can make imagemeta.Decode allocate excessive memory from declared chunk lengths or unbounded zlib decompression. Untrusted images can exhaust a decoding worker.

severity.rationale: Attacker-controlled images reach memory allocations during metadata decoding. The documented impact is denial of service, without code execution or secret disclosure.

exposure: Processing untrusted PNG images with IPTC metadata enabled reaches the affected decoding paths.

remediation.details: Upgrade to 0.17.3 or later. If IPTC metadata is unnecessary, the advisory offers clearing IPTC from Options.Sources as a workaround.
remediation.risk: Low. Disabling IPTC removes that metadata from results.

verification: Confirm the resolved library version and check ordinary PNG metadata extraction after updating.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record from directly inspected primary evidence; independent review pending.
